04-26-1871 + 16 weeks = 16 × 7 = 112 days → 112 days + 1 day = 113 days.  
April has 30 days, so from April 26: 4 days left in April (30-26=4).  
113 - 4 = 109 days left.  
May 31 days, June 30 days, July 31 days: 4+31+30+31=96 days used by end of July.  
109 - 96 = 13 days into August → August 13, 1871.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1871-08-13
